category.instructions: Classify the issue described in the message.

criteria.technical: Software failures, errors, crashes, slowness and outages
criteria.account: Login, profile, membership and account settings
criteria.other: Anything that is not a billing, technical or account issue

intent.instructions: Decide what the user wants the assistant to do with this message.

criteria.create_task: Create a task, to-do or follow-up to be done later
criteria.query_status: Ask about the status or progress of existing work
criteria.capture_note: Record information or an idea without creating a task
criteria.none: Greetings, small talk or questions unrelated to the user's work
